snippet.title: Resonant Blade - Official Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
⚔️ Resonant Blade is OUT NOW on Steam!
🎵 Harness sound. Slice through chaos. Unleash the Resonant Tones.

Get it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092270/Resonant_Blade/
Launch Discount: 10% off for a limited time!

About the Game:
Resonant Blade is a pixel-art sci-fi action-adventure where you wield a legendary weapon powered by sound. Explore a post-apocalyptic world, parry deadly attacks, and uncover the truth behind the Dark Synth uprising.

🔊 Master frequency-based combat
🧩 Solve puzzles with sound-based resonance
⚙️ Upgrade with mods and uncover hidden secrets
🌆 Traverse neon-lit cities, ruined labs, and hostile wastelands
🎶 Original synth-infused soundtrack

🐦 Follow on X: https://x.com/WiseWombatGames
💬 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/62wfpgA9vV
🌐 Website: https://www.resonantblade.com/

#ResonantBlade #IndieGame #LaunchTrailer #PixelArt #SciFiGame #ActionAdventure #SteamGames
